## Axe-Hand Morgan

The tyrant captain of the 153rd Branch ruled Shells Town by fear and an axe bolted to his wrist.

Win the Axe-Hand Morgan challenge from the Challenges menu.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Higuma the Bear](01_romance_dawn.md#q-7c510d231eb03ae8)

**Tasks**

- Defeat Axe-Hand Morgan

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,500

## Strongest of Your Blue

Word travels fast in a Blue. Beat enough of its villains and the newspapers start printing your name.

Defeat any four villains on this page, reach 1,500 Doriki and land on six different islands.

Requires any 4 of: Axe-Hand Morgan, Kuro of a Hundred Plans, The Nyaban Brothers, Don Krieg, Gin the Man-Demon, Ironwall Pearl, Kuroobi, Chew, Arlong the Saw

**Tasks**

- Reach 1,500 Doriki
- Land on 6 different islands

**Rewards**

- Doriki +300, Belly +10,000, Rookie Crate

<a id="q-638c84648603807b"></a>

## The Town of the Beginning and the End

**Optional quest.**

Gol D. Roger was born and executed in Loguetown. Luffy stood on the same platform and grinned at the sword.

Land on a harbour town in your home Blue.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Strongest of Your Blue](02_villains_of_the_blues.md#q-497f71c2917c479e)

**Tasks**

- Land on a harbour town in your home Blue

**Rewards**

- Doriki +180, Belly +6,000
